description: This file defines the Calendar class for SuiteCRM, handling calendar views, activities, and related utilities within the module. It manages calendar display, activity loading, date navigation, and user preferences.

classes.name: Calendar
classes.description: Represents the calendar component in SuiteCRM, managing views, activities, date calculations, and user preferences.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Calendar object, setting view, date, preferences, and calculating grid start and day range.

methods.name: load_activities
methods.description: Loads activity data into the calendar's items array based on current activities.

methods.name: init_shared
methods.description: Initializes shared user IDs for calendar sharing.

methods.name: calculate_grid_start_ts
methods.description: Calculates the timestamp for the start of the calendar grid based on the current view.

methods.name: calculate_day_range
methods.description: Calculates the number of slots per day and the start/end times for the working day.

methods.name: add_activities
methods.description: Adds activities for a user within the current date range, supporting different views.

methods.name: get_neighbor_date_str
methods.description: Returns the date string of the previous or next calendar grid based on the current view.

methods.name: isPrint
methods.description: Returns whether the calendar is in print mode.
